record.label: Description-logics sample README
record.evidence_description: Repository README stating that replacing LLM reasoning with ontological reasoning yields provably correct answers, describing the self-modifying-program loop, and stating that description logic has no declarative query language.

record.label: Description-logics sample control harness
record.evidence_description: The evolve loop: seed, execute, judge, write TASK.md, invoke the external coding agent, repeat until judged accuracy crosses the threshold or max_iterations is reached.

record.label: Description-logics sample fixer
record.evidence_description: The repair step that writes TASK.md and spawns kiro-cli over a PTY, including the prompt-stated rule that core reasoning must use owlready2 and the instruction not to emit ontology identifiers.

record.label: Description-logics sample seed program
record.evidence_description: The degenerate seed program that loads the OWL file through owlready2 and always answers 'I don't know', carrying the stated contract that the LLM never sees the answer.

record.label: Description-logics sample final evolved program
record.evidence_description: The shipped final evolved query program: SQLite retrieval over asserted axioms followed by an LLM narration step prompted to add pathophysiology and clinical significance beyond the retrieved set.
notes: Byte-identical to assets/sample-run/iteration_3/query_program.py (same sha256) although a 12,235-byte changes.patch separates the two iterations; the fixer overwrites the per-iteration program in place, so the stored artifact for iteration N is the post-fix program.

record.label: Text-to-SQL planner README
record.evidence_description: Repository README stating the near-SOTA BIRD claim, the 'unsat or nothing' emission contract, the documented operator table, and the deliberate exclusion of row order and count from the equivalence proof.

record.label: Text-to-SQL planner entry point
record.evidence_description: Deterministic SQL generation from the proven operator tree, including the simplifier fixpoint and the skip for UNION and EXCEPT derived tables.

record.label: Text-to-SQL planner loop
record.evidence_description: The greedy forward-chaining plan loop, operator self-validation before state mutation, the cvc5 goal test, the salvage re-check, and the best_indeterminate_node return path.

record.label: Text-to-SQL planner LLM client
record.evidence_description: The four narrow Bedrock calls, the forced tool call whose input schema enumerates the legal operators, and the DISTINCT decision that defaults to False on infrastructure failure.

record.label: Text-to-SQL equivalence checker
record.evidence_description: The cvc5 equivalence decision including the cheap pre-checks that protect the solver, and the syntactic function-name match used for aggregate equivalence.

record.label: Text-to-SQL BIRD evaluation harness
record.evidence_description: The BIRD dual-signal harness: cvc5 logical equivalence against a DRC translation of the gold SQL with injected foreign-key axioms and a projection-tolerance retry, alongside SQLite execution comparison.

record.label: Kinetics research agent README

record.label: Kinetics research agent engine
record.evidence_description: The two nested propose, execute, critique and repair loops, the sandbox-per-edit artifact chain, the executability gate on stderr and exit code, and the critique-then-classify gates.

record.label: Kinetics research agent utilities
record.evidence_description: The unsandboxed subprocess invocation with trust-all-tools, the example-code lookup, and extract_result_block which reduces a free-text critique to a True or False token.

record.label: Kinetics research agent analysis types

record.evidence_description: The StuckSignal design: an open dictionary of normalized measured signals combined into a weighted score behind a domain-extensible trigger factory that decides when a meta-agent is dispatched.

record.label: Position of the symbolic layer in the write path
record.axis_definition: Position of the symbolic layer in the write path: admission gate at write time vs verification of output at read time vs no symbolic layer. Question: can an invalid or ungrounded assertion ever enter the store and be read later?

record.label: Expressivity and pinning of the constraint language
record.axis_definition: Expressivity and pinning of the constraint language: type conformance, decidable description-logic entailment, Horn rules over compiled facts, or ad-hoc checks - and is the rule program content-pinned? Question: what class of error can the system catch, and can a check's result be reproduced later?

record.label: Rejection preserved as a typed record
record.axis_definition: Does a rejection produce a preserved typed record, or a silent retry or discard? Question: is the failure surface auditable; can rejection rate be measured over time? Ask each repository: what happens to attempt N-1 after a failed verification?

record.label: Validation separated from epistemic acceptance
record.axis_definition: Does passing validation constitute acceptance, or is structural commitment held separate from epistemic acceptance and action authorization? Question: does a validated write silently become a truth claim the system acts on?

record.label: Persistence and verified reach of the reasoning trace
record.axis_definition: Persistence and reach of the reasoning trace: per-query discarded, per-session, per-problem-namespace, or genuinely cross-problem - scored on VERIFIED reach. Question: does structure accumulate knowledge, or is it scaffolding rebuilt every call? (autoresearch-et's own audit shows claimed reach can fail in practice - score everyone on verified reach.)

record.label: Control of meta-reasoning dispatch
record.axis_definition: Control of meta-reasoning: inline, deterministic every step, or gated dispatch on externally measured telemetry. Question: what decides WHEN the expensive reasoning component runs, and does that depend on LLM self-report? Discriminator: skip rate.

record.label: Reach of the meta or symbolic component's output
record.axis_definition: Does the meta or symbolic component's output reach the search mechanism, or only the prompt? Question: can the reasoning layer FORCE an action, or only advise? A symbolic layer that only advises looks neurosymbolic on the diagram and behaves like a prompt suffix in the ablation.

record.label: Evidence discipline of the reported result
record.axis_definition: Evidence discipline: pre-registered bands with a same-model naive control and per-item attribution, vs aggregate benchmark accuracy. Question: would this system's own authors have been able to report a null? Does an ablation isolate the symbolic layer at all?
